--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-like strategy that starts C and defects when recent opponent defections are high. The trace simulates the 12-strategy population and payoffs, and considers adding final-round defection and exploiting thresholds in strategies like slot 5. It changes the strategy by planning to cooperate until round 99 and defect on round 100, while avoiding early probing against retaliatory opponents.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "So the optimal against this population might simply be: always cooperate, except defect on the last round." / "Thus, the population is mostly retaliatory. The best strategy is to be nice, retaliate only when necessary, and defect on the last round."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-like retaliator with thresholds; the trace simulates the 12-slot population (slot0 forgiving, slot5 cooperative-threshold, slot6 endgame exploiter, etc.) and computes payoffs; it proposes adding a last-round defection and an adaptive probe/exploit cycle (defect ~20% after detecting a non-retaliator).

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Given the general advice emphasizes forgiveness and preserving mutual cooperation, I'll design a strategy that is mostly cooperative, retaliates to defections, but forgives quickly, and exploits only when safe."
STRATEGY: The parent is a threshold-based strategy that retaliates to opponent defections and defects when recent defection counts/ratios cross thresholds. The trace simulates it against TFT, slot0, slot2, and slot5, then designs a replacement that cooperates initially, exploits only while the opponent has never defected (defecting every 5th round after round 10), uses forgiving tit-for-tat with a 0.3 forgiveness probability after opponent defections, and always defects on the last round.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates initially, defects periodically when opponent has never defected, and uses probabilistic forgiveness after opponent defections. Simulated against slot5, slot0, TFT, slot4, slot6, and other retaliators. Changed by adding endgame defections at n>=98 when opp_def==0, adjusting retaliatory branch to punish consistent defectors, and adding n==99 defection when opp_def>0.
